name: superplan
description: Conversation-scoped persistent planning with task-completion gating and pressure-gated checkpoints, cumulative detailed history, concurrent-session isolation, and bounded compaction recovery for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Conversation-scoped persistent planning for Codex and Claude Code (Linux/WSL)
interface.longDescription: Persist one conversation-scoped plan container with a task-completion-gated current-task plan, cumulative detailed findings/progress, pressure-gated checkpoints, concurrent session isolation, and bounded compaction recovery. Works in both Codex and Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use $superplan to keep one persistent plan container across later tasks in this conversation.
